scope: isolated transport microbenchmark; not a camera, detector, CaptureSource mailbox, or client-delivery benchmark

workload.payload_content_model: one deterministic RGB8 payload template repeated for every frame record in each arm
workload.payload_preparation_and_sha256: generated and SHA-256 checked during arm setup/readiness; excluded from measured frame loops
workload.timed_operations: steady-state bounded handoff and parent frame-record reads/copies; frame payload equality uses the setup-verified repeated template

camera_source_to_parent_latency.reason: No camera source or comparable camera clock is used by this experiment.

detector_accuracy_and_latency.reason: No detector or image interpretation is invoked by this experiment.

process_cpu_time.reason: CPU time is not sampled by this portable microbenchmark.

resident_memory.reason: Per-process RSS is not sampled by this portable microbenchmark.

operating_system_pipe_capacity.reason: The pipe buffer is bounded by the operating system but its active capacity is not queried by this portable microbenchmark.

capture_mailbox_and_client_delivery.reason: The production capture mailbox and client delivery path are not exercised.
